title: VDBE bound-value copy, affinity, and reoptimization variable mask

scope.rationale: sqlite3VdbeGetBoundValue and sqlite3VdbeSetVarmask are the planner/reprepare boundary for bound parameters: one returns a caller-owned affinity-applied copy while preserving the binding, and the other records parameters whose rebinding may change a query plan.
excluded_responsibilities: Public bind APIs and binding mutation

external_source_responsibilities: Source-equivalent Mem copy, affinity and sqlite3ValueFree lifecycle
dependencies.caller_closure: Both active bound-value/reoptimization functions are assigned. Exact aVar/nVar/expmask owners and Mem allocator behavior are dependency-covered; public binding/planner callers remain open.

inputs: nullable Vdbe, positive one-based variable index, affinity; or positive variable index for mask
outputs: null for null Vdbe/SQL NULL/OOM, otherwise new caller-owned Mem copy with affinity; updated expmask
contracts.ownership: Original aVar remains Vdbe-owned and unchanged. Successful GetBoundValue creates one connection-owned sqlite3_value for caller release.
contracts.state_and_results: Mask sets bit iVar-1 for indices 1..31 and saturates all indices >=32 into bit 31. Existing bits remain set.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds connection mutex. No callback or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Value allocation OOM returns null with sticky connection OOM and leaves binding unchanged. SQL NULL returns null without allocation.

representation_differences: sqlite3_value is the exact Mem representation in both C and Zig.
Affinity is passed as the canonical byte value and applied by the existing source-shaped Mem helper.

oracle.protocol: The shared worker packages two variables, binds integer and NULL values, retrieves affinity-applied copies, sets mask indices 1/31/32, disables lookaside, and forces value-copy allocation OOM. C and Zig compare 366 observations.
internal_observations: OOM null result and sticky flag
source binding remains available for OOM attempt
oracle.normalization: Returned pointers normalize to null/non-null; flags, integer values, masks and OOM state are exact.

assurance.oom: Deterministic value-allocation OOM is reached with lookaside disabled; return is null and sticky state matches.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O/callback; caller mutex remains integration obligation.
assurance.malformed_input: Source asserts positive indices and QPSG/InternalFunc compatibility; worker uses valid indexes with QPSG disabled.
assurance.continuation: Successful copies are freed immediately; source bindings survive copies, NULL checks, mask updates, and failed copy.
assurance.performance: Direct one-based array access, one conditional copy, and constant-time bit updates.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker reaches exact packaged aVar and connection allocator. Public bind/reoptimize callers remain partially handwritten.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Integrate public bind and planner reoptimization paths.

independent_review.notes: Requires bind/planner integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Structured implementation spans, callers, callees, branches/cleanup, and upstream-test context must be recorded before promotion.
Integrate public bindings and planner reoptimization with source Vdbe aVar/expmask.
Complete Vdbe reset/final destruction of bound values.
